plans.rationale: Early round (coverage 0.03). Occupied cells cluster at [3,4], [4,4], [4,5] with best voltage 3.827 at [3,4]. Target 7 adjacent empty/sparse frontier cells to expand diversity locally while avoiding duplicates. Weight strain and rattle equally (0.4 each) for structural exploration around seeds; permute at 0.2 for cation ordering variations. Dopants listed for future substitute operator when unlocked.

Expand from the occupied cluster ([3,3]-[5,5]) into 8 empty frontier cells adjacent to occupied ones. Strain produced the best voltage (3.96 at [5,4]), so weight it highest (0.5). Rattle (0.3) for local structural diversity. Permute (0.2) for cation ordering but lower to limit duplicates (2 so far, both at [5,6]). Avoid [5,6] which generated duplicates. Target cells are all unoccupied neighbors of current occupied cells.

Permute (0.2) for cation ordering but kept low to limit duplicates (3 so far, all at [5,6] which is avoided). Target 8 empty frontier cells adjacent to occupied cluster, prioritizing expansion from the high-voltage region around [6,4] and [6,5] ([7,4], [7,5], [6,3], [6,6], [5,3]) and filling gaps ([4,3], [3,5], [4,6]).
